policy.reference: All <w> lexical content in all four official AMI word files, including fillers and partial words
policy.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lower case, curly apostrophe to ASCII, alphanumeric words with internal apostrophes; punctuation separates words
policy.wordOrder: All words sorted by original start time, original end time, speaker and XML order; overlap ordering is a limitation of single-stream WER
policy.excluded: Non-word XML nodes only; no manual synonym, abbreviation, numeral, filler or disfluency rewrites

englishQualityTarget.status: explicit conservative extension for English ordinary-meeting development; not an existing Chinese CER definition

policy.qualityQualificationRequires: Complete final document, per-person words and activity, ordinary/complex conditions and original independent meeting coverage; raw WER alone cannot qualify product
